name: skillmaps
description: Side panes along the AI Hero skills: grill-map for a grilling's design tree, wayfinder-map for a /wayfinder map, spec-map for a spec from its tickets to the merge

grill.title: grill-map
grill.description: The design tree of /grilling, /grill-me and /grill-with-docs, one level per round.

wayfinder.title: wayfinder-map
wayfinder.description: The /wayfinder map as a graph from start to destination, its decisions, fog and each ticket's grilling.

spec.title: spec-map
spec.description: A spec from idea to merge: the stage, what each subagent is doing, the tickets and the integration PR.

slots.title: spec-map implementer slots
slots.description: How many implementers may run at once, drawn as spec-map's slot meter. 0 reads the cap from the skill that runs ("3 slots"), or draws none.
